## Warg Rider (6×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 2x Warg Rider
- Type: Elite, Bio, Cavalry, Walking
- Points: 40
- Shaken: slow [-, -, flee] / Can't use weapons

- **Fire Order**: only available if given ranged weapons

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 5+ | unit shaken |

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 2-3 | Bleeding[6] |
| 4-6 | Bleeding[6], +1 to future damage, Psychic damage[d6] |
| 7+ | kill 1 model, Psychic damage[d6] |
- When one model is killed, half all +1 to future damage rounded down
- If killed by poison or bleeding, remove that instance


### Warg Rider

## Speedhead (4×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 1x Speedhead
- Type: Bio Crew, Mechanical, Vehicle, Tracked
- Armor: 8/7/7/7
- Points: 72
- Shaken: still [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons

- **Fire Order**: Fire and load both rear guns (Speed Cannon and Shriek) simultaneously, and track ammo simultaneously. All targets of both weapons must be within the same angle, but not necessarily same target. Flamethrower: may always be fired in any shooting step as long as you still have ammo left. Do not need an order to do so
- **Pre-Assault Retreat**: [4+]

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-3 | +1 to future damage |
| 4 | as 1-3, shaken |
| 5-8 | 4, Critical Damage[d6] |
| 9+ | unit destroyed |

**Damage Table: Critical**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-3 | +3 to future damage |
| 4 | Cannot rotate |
| 5 | -1 to hit, +1 to be hit (ranged and assault) |
| 6 | Unit set on fire |

**Damage Table: Crew**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 4-5 | Crippled Crew, if already shaken double initial Crew damage |
| 6-7 | as 4-5, shaken |
| 8-11 | as 6-7, +3 to future Crew damage |
| 12+ | Unit destroyed |


### Speedhead

- Equipment: 1x Flamethrower, 1x Speed Cannon, 1x Shriek
- Assault: strength 8/6/4/4 (6+), deflection 2/1/0/0 (6+), damage d8, AP 3


- **Ork Reroll**: [6]

#### Flamethrower

- Range: 1, angle True/False/False/False, damage N.A, AP 0
- **Area**: Fire at all possible hexes possible simultaneously: Area(3+) at point blank range, Area(4+) in the hex at long range directly ahead, and Area(5+) for the two hexes which is on long range and on edge of firing arc.
- **Range Extra Damage**: Fire
- **Limited Ammo**: [3]

#### Speed Cannon

- Range: 2, angle False/False/True/True, damage d6+1, AP 6
- **Burst**: [5]

#### Shriek

- Range: 3, angle False/False/True/True, damage d4-2+ d6 Psychic damage, AP 2
- **Burst**: [5]
